name: Four Seasons Hotel Cairo at Nile Plaza
positioning: A 30-storey hotel on the Corniche along the Nile in Cairo's Garden City, with Art Deco furnishings and nine restaurants and lounges
best_for: Travelers who want a Nile-side city base with many dining options
Guests who want rooms with private terraces over the Nile

facts.text: The hotel has 371 rooms and suites: 270 guest rooms and 101 suites.
The hotel is on the Corniche along the bank of the Nile River, in the Garden City section of Cairo.
The design aesthetic is a modern building enhanced by Art Deco furnishings and contemporary Egyptian art.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours and has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Nile.
Zitouni is the hotel's Egyptian restaurant.
Riviera is the hotel's Italian coastal restaurant.

highlights.text: Selected Premium Rooms and Suites have interiors by Pierre Yves Rochon.
Many of the rooms and suites have private terraces overlooking the Nile and Cairo's skyline.
The Cleopatra Bath Ritual includes a soothing milk bath with honey and rose petals.
The hotel's lobby art gallery houses more than 200 paintings and sculptures.
Every Friday, Zitouni serves an Egyptian brunch buffet with 360-degree views of the Nile River.

considerations.text: The indoor adult pool has a minimum age requirement of 16.
Cairo International Airport is a 45-minute drive from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may have city noise.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
